text:
Snow, lights and hot wine under the TV Tower ❄️

This is Sapporo's Odori Park in December, when the White Illumination (46 years running) and the Munich Christmas Market share the same park.

The market's mug has a new design every year.

More winter places like this on our page: follow Japan by Station for one Japan place a day.
